summary.text: VÆRK AS is a private limited company registered in Gamle Fredrikstad, founded 2018-04-03. VÆRK AS drives restaurant, bar og catering, og skal også fokusere på kurs/konferanser og kulturarrangementer, samt det som står i naturlig forbindelse med dette. It was previously named VÆRK CATERING AS until 2021-02-24. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 227 779 NOK and the annual result was 7 568 NOK; operating income was down from 6 319 819 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -333 080 NOK in 2024 to 7 568 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -824 775 NOK in 2024 to 2 793 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is vaerk.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The latest news on its own website is "En julehilsen fra Værk" from 2025-12-22. The registered employee count went from 18 on 2025-11-12 to 21 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-16 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
